newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Cariplo to open talks with Ambroveneto.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Cariplo to open talks with Ambroveneto.

text.p: The foundation that controls Italy's largest savings bank Cariplo on Monday voted to open talks on merger with Italian banking group Ambroveneto.
The chairman of the foundation Giuseppe Guzzetti told journalists that the foundation had voted unanimously to open merger talks with Ambroveneto.
Guzzetti told journalists after the meeting that the committee's decision had been quick and unanimous. "Now we will will write to Ambroveneto and say that we are ready to negotiate."
He confirmed that there were only two contenders for an alliance with Cariplo, and Guzzetti added that he would be happy if a formal draft between the two banking groups could be drawn up by June 30.

The foundation's central committee that controls the Milan-based Cariplo met on Monday to decide on forming an alliance with either of two Italian banks -- Banco Ambrosiano Veneto (Ambroveneto) or Banca Commerciale Italiana.
Cariplo, which is aiming for privatisation this year, is being advised in the talks over a banking alliance by investment bank Goldman Sachs.
